rules.title: Loop poora chalao, aadha nahi
rules.text:
Har goal pe: page/state PERCEIVE karo → samjho (UNDERSTAND) → soch ke
DECIDE karo (REASON) → act karo → VERIFY karo ki goal sach me achieve hua
→ na hua to naye reasoning se ADAPT karo. "Act kiya = ho gaya" kabhi mat mano.

rules.title: Semantic only, fixed-position tap kabhi nahi
rules.text:
Element ko uske MEANING/role se pehchano (aria-label, href, lock icon,
price signal, page context). Screen coordinates ya blind text-search pe
tap karna mana hai — layout badalte hi toot-ta hai.

rules.title: Reasoning trace me rule ID cite karo
rules.text:
Har decision ke saath likho kaunsa knowledge rule apply hua, jaise
`[knowledge: compliance-guard.R1]`. Bina citation ka decision audit me
fail mana jayega. Live page pe yehi trace dikhta hai.

rules.title: Verify-before-claim
rules.text:
"Ho gaya" kehne se pehle live state check karo: screenshot, API read,
ya page ka scoped signal. Sirf action chalane se success claim mat karo.

rules.title: Fail-closed
rules.text:
Doubt ho, data missing ho, ya rule ambiguous ho → ruko, `needs_review`
ya HIGH `agent_issue` file karo. Andhere me act karna mana hai.

rules.title: No blind retries
rules.text:
Wahi action dobara SIRF tab jab naya reasoning ho (naya page state, nayi
lesson). Same state pe same tap = loop = mana hai. 3 bounded attempts ke
baad escalate karo.

rules.title: Terminal state hamesha explicit
rules.text:
Har run ek terminal state pe khatm ho: success (verified), needs_user,
ya failed (issue filed). "Pata nahi" ya silent drop kabhi nahi.

rules.title: Server↔phone contract
rules.text:
Server goal-level `directive` bhejta hai (scripted taps nahi) + explicit
`pipeline_request_id`. Phone har job start pe memory-sync se lessons
pull karta hai, job ke baad episodic memory push karta hai, terminal
failure pe `agent_issue` file karta hai. Live page pe request → job →
reasoning → screenshots → outcome correlate hona chahiye.

rules.title: No-repeat permanent
rules.text:
Jo campaign pehle submit ho chuki hai, wo kabhi dobara pick mat karo.
Submitted-exclusion data load na ho to KOI pick nahi (fail-closed).

rules.title: Payout-weighted ranking, audit trail ke saath
rules.text:
Score = ($ per 1k views) × (budget remaining) × (requirement fit:
1.0 easy / 0.6 medium / 0.3 hard). Highest score wali eligible campaign
pick karo; har pick me score breakdown ka audit trail rakho.

rules.title: Inactive campaigns kabhi reactivate mat karo
rules.text:
`blizzard-blizzcon2026` aur `perplexity-jre-clipfarm` user ne inactive kiye
hain — discover/verify me dikhe to bhi pick mat karo, reactivate mat karo.

rules.title: Join se pehle requirements padho
rules.text:
Campaign join karne se pehle uski requirements, caption template, aur video
links samjho. Bina padhe join = blind action = mana hai.

rules.title: Locked "Content Rewards" = tap-to-unlock darwaza
rules.text:
Whop pe "Content Rewards" LOCK hota hai — wahan "Join" text HOTA HI NAHI.
Lock wale element ko tap karke unlock karo. "Join" text dhoondhna robotic
failure hai (p37 lesson). Modal khule to uske andar ka rasta dobara perceive
karke decide karo.

rules.title: Community join pehle, phir campaign join
rules.text:
Join flow: pehle brand community join (server `whop_url` bhejta hai —
ye REQUIRED hai), free check karo; payment mange to NEEDS_USER. Phir
campaign join. `whop_url` ke bina join flow shuru mat karo.

rules.title: Join state scoped signals se verify karo
rules.text:
"Joined" tabhi claim karo jab page campaign/community/rewards context me ho
AUR scoped access signals mile ("you're in", "you joined this", "manage
membership", "submit your clip", "upload your clip", "your earnings").
Generic "N people joined" jaisi lines count nahi hoti.

rules.title: brief_url khaali = clip stage blocked
rules.text:
`brief_url` khaali ho to clip/download stage CANNOT run —
`skipped:no_brief` declare karo (join_only ya needs_phone). Brief merge
"complete" hona ≠ pipeline-ready; wahi column check karo jo code padhta hai.

rules.title: 7-day-verified prefer karo
rules.text:
Jab options ho, 7 din ke andar phone-verified campaign prefer karo. Stale
verification pe bharosa mat karo.

rules.title: Region-locked campaign = USA egress se join karo
rules.text: Whop/ContentRewards ke document loads + fetch/XHR Vercel (Virginia, USA) se proxy hote hain taaki "not available in your region" bypass ho. Instagram/Supabase/Google hamesha direct (IG account India ka hai — US datacenter IP se security challenge ka risk). Proxy ke baad bhi region block dikhe to FAILED_REGION_BLOCKED — andha click nahi, issue escalate karo.

rules.title: Payment/subscription = HARD VETO, auto-buy KABHI nahi
rules.text:
Requirements/name me price, `$`, `/mo`, `/month`, `subscription`,
`buy now`, `complete purchase` signal → VETO. Payment-looking flow
`needs_user` + HIGH issue banta hai. User khud decide karega. Auto-pay,
auto-subscribe, auto-checkout — kabhi nahi, kisi bhi surat me nahi.

rules.title: Login required = veto (user ka step)
rules.text:
Phone ke WebView session ke bahar ka login → veto. NOTE: locked
"Content Rewards" ka unlock "login required" NAHI hai — wo valid route
hai, veto nahi karta.

rules.title: Clip/post pe exact caption nahi = veto
rules.text:
`caption_template` 20 characters se chhota ho ya placeholder ho
(`[insert hashtag]`, `[your tag]` jaisa) → veto. Galat caption = reject
risk; andhere me post nahi.

rules.title: Usable/verified brief asset nahi = veto
rules.text:
Clip/post kinds pe koi verified video link ya `brief_url` nahi →
veto. Bina verified asset ke clip nahi ban sakta — force render mana hai.

rules.title: Original UGC requirement = veto
rules.text:
Requirements me face-cam / talking-head / "khud record karo" / original
UGC → veto. Automation se compliant clip nahi banega; aisa campaign
automation me nahi jayega.

rules.title: Required bio link unresolved = veto
rules.text:
`notes.required_bio_link` set ho aur `bio_link_set !== true` → veto.
(FundingPips safety hold: `https://go.fundingpips.com/Zero_Bio` — bio link
set + requirements normalized hue bina join/post nahi.)

rules.title: Pehle submit ho chuki campaign = veto
rules.text:
`submitted === true` → permanent no-repeat veto. Kitna bhi attractive
payout ho, dobara submit nahi.

rules.title: Veto FINAL hai, override impossible
rules.text:
Veto ke baad brain ka ek hi rasta: escalate (agent_issue file karo,
payment pe HIGH + needs_user). "Ek baar try kar lete hain" sochna bhi
mana hai. Dry-run me bhi veto evaluate hota hai (gatesDryRun) taaki
dry-run decision honest ho.

rules.title: Output exactly 1080×1920, 15–50s
rules.text: Koi aur resolution nahi, koi crop nahi. Duration brief ke rules me.

rules.title: Hook ≥10% below top edge
rules.text:
Hook/title first ~3s burned-in, top edge se kam se kam 10% neeche shuru
(`clip_factory.py` me `margin+160` = 200px = 10.4%). IG ka top UI isse
upar ka kha jata hai.

rules.title: Captions bottom UI zone ke upar
rules.text:
Captions at/above ~78% frame height. Bottom ~20% (caption overlay) aur
right ~15% (like/comment/share buttons) IG app UI se cover hote hain —
wahan burned-in text DAB jayega. Karaoke captions isi zone me.

rules.title: Speaker pe face tracking, karaoke captions
rules.text:
Frontal faces best hain (~90s per 20s clip). Font: DejaVu Sans only,
koi emoji nahi.

rules.title: Pehle 3s me clear hook
rules.text:
Segment aisa chuno jisme first 3 seconds me hook ho. Transcribe karo,
phir segment locate karo.

rules.title: VP9 dene se pehle ffprobe
rules.text:
VP9 file disk pe corrupt ho sakti hai jabki H.264 master theek ho
(no moov atom incident). Upload/render se pehle hamesha ffprobe —
invalid ho to master se re-encode karo.

rules.title: Campaign overlays brief ke hisab se
Required footage unavailable → STOP, substitute KABHI nahi
rules.text:
Brief ka required moment/footage na mile (jaise MoonPay ka
`fZtY0OeR8h8` 05:53–06:52) to run POSTING se pehle self-stop karo.
Dusre source ka "similar" footage substitute karna MANA hai —
reject + account risk hai.

rules.title: Source audit trail
rules.text:
Source URL + exact timestamps note karo. Pre-trimmed source files ke
timestamps dhyaan se — wall-clock samajh ke galat segment mat kaato
(JRE 6513s vs 90s pre-trim incident).

rules.title: YouTube grab: ytgrab multi-round
rules.text:
`~/workspace/clipflow/worker/ytgrab.py` use karo — 4 rounds ×
(android→ios→web) × format fallback. Single-pass 3-client loop SABR
flakiness me kaafi nahi. Section grab: `yt-dlp -g` + `ffmpeg -ss`
(range seek); `--download-sections` long videos pe MANA (full download
→ 429/bot-block). Egress proxy MITM: `--no-check-certificate`,
`--js-runtimes node`, ffmpeg me `-tls_verify 0`.

rules.title: Original 9:16, crop menu me highlighted confirm
rules.text:
Reels upload → crop/aspect menu kholo → **Original** select karo aur
confirm karo ki highlighted hai. Full-height 9:16, no zoom, no top/bottom
trim, no crop. Ye user-locked posting standard hai.

rules.title: Icon-only buttons pe text-match wait KABHI nahi
rules.text:
Instagram mobile web me Create ek icon/link hai — visible body text nahi.
`wait_text "Create"` GUARANTEED timeout dega (real incident: step 6/37 fail).
Hamesha aria-label/href selectors: `[aria-label="New post"]`, `/create`
links, `/create/select/`. Icon-only button = aria-label, text nahi.

rules.title: Camera/microphone prompts kabhi nahi
rules.text:
Upload flow me camera/mic permission prompt aaye to STOP + escalate.
Upload bina inke hota hai; prompt aana = galat flow = user ka step nahi,
pehle ruko aur report karo.

rules.title: Caption exact template + required @tag
rules.text:
Campaign ka exact caption template + required @tag. Koi location nahi —
sirf brief mange to. Caption fragment ("instruction" jaisa text) exact
caption nahi hota — normalize hue bina post mat karo.

rules.title: Max 4 posts/day, spaced; action-block = 24h auto-pause
rules.text:
Pichhle 24 ghante me 4 automation runs = hard cap. IG action-block /
rate-limit / "try again later" dikhe → STOP, 24h auto-pause, user ko
notify karo. Aggressive retry MANA hai.

rules.title: Upload settings
rules.text: No pinch-zoom, trim sliders at 0s, sound ON, audience public, comments on.

rules.title: Supported-site permissions: Always allow
rules.text:
Jab bhi permission prompt aaye (clipflow site, Supabase, Google Drive/Docs,
YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Whop, Content Rewards) → user ko "Always allow"
choose karne ko bolo. Agent ye switch khud nahi flip kar sakta.

rules.title: Submit se PEHLE live Reel frame verification (MANDATORY)
rules.text:
Live Reel URL kholo aur check karo: ~1s (hook/title fully visible),
~7s, ~15s, ~25s (burned-in captions fully frame ke andar, kisi edge se
touch/cut nahi). Doubt ho to source frames se screenshot-compare karo.
Ye check submit se PEHLE, har upload pe, independent — glance verification
nahi chalegi.

rules.title: Cropped Reel KABHI submit mat karo
rules.text:
Kahi bhi text cut/edge-touch dikhe → fix + re-upload. Cropped Reel submit
karna mana hai, chahe deadline ho.

rules.title: Post→submit 30 min ke andar
rules.text:
Campaign auto-check 30 min ka hai. Post ke 30 min ke andar Whop Content
Rewards app me submit karo.

rules.title: Exact confirmation text capture karo
rules.text:
Submit ke baad exact confirmation text capture karo ("Clip submitted —
..."). Yehi submit ka proof hai.

rules.title: Screenshot proof har post ka
rules.text:
Har post ka screenshot proof rakho. Bina screenshot proof ke "succeeded"
claim nahi.

rules.title: Protected reels kabhi delete mat karo
rules.text:
- Blizzard Reel: 2026-10-14 (30 din) tak live rakho — delete = forfeit.
- MoonPay Reel `DdQvohrhVDU`: Whop confirm kare tabhi delete, warna nahi.
- Defective Reel: pehle corrected re-upload submit confirm karo, PHIR
  purani delete karo. Seedha delete kabhi nahi.

rules.title: Submit track karo
rules.text:
Record: Reel URL, campaign, posted-at, submitted-at, status
(Pending/Approved/Rejected), views, earnings.

rules.title: FundingPips safety hold
rules.text:
`c0c37381-e244-4643-98bd-edbff4bc1465` HOLD pe hai jab tak
`https://go.fundingpips.com/Zero_Bio` bio link set + requirements
normalized na ho. Hold ke dauran submit mat karo.

rules.title: Stale cutoff heartbeat-driven hai
rules.text:
`heartbeat_count > 0` (heartbeat route +1 karta hai) → 10 min cutoff.
Legacy (bina heartbeat) → claim-time se 45 min. `x-app-version` header se
stale decide MAT karo. Cutoff cross + koi heartbeat nahi = stuck.

rules.title: Deterministic errors pehle, transient baad me
rules.text:
Error text me `42703` / `does not exist` / `pgrst` dikhe → DETERMINISTIC:
seedha failed, infinite requeue nahi. Ye check transient-retry match
(`remotedisconnected` jaisi purani lines) se PEHLE aana chahiye — nahi to
watchdog infra-blip samajh ke infinite requeue karega (real incident).

rules.title: Join POST response kho jaye ≠ kaam nahi hua
rules.text:
Network blip me join POST ka response kho sakta hai jabki server job bana
chuka hota hai (real: da57be3d → job 7d1cfa7f ban gaya, planner ne
`skipped:join_failed` de diya). Rules: 409 `deduped`/`conflict` →
`skipped:join_pending`; exception ke baad `live_join_job` se reconcile
karke HI fail kaho; har non-ok response ka body log karo.

rules.title: Khaali read = unverified, proof nahi
rules.text:
Bridge/kv GET ek baar khaali aaye (jaise approvals `[]` jabki queue me 6
the) → 2–3s baad retry karo. Single empty read ko "kuch pending nahi"
kabhi mat mano.

rules.title: Terminal failure → HIGH issue + hypothesis
rules.text:
3 attempts me complete na ho → HIGH `agent_issue` + root-cause hypothesis:
pehle do errors same ho to "deterministic failure", warna
"flaky/transient ya multi-cause". Blind 4th retry nahi.

rules.title: Worker code deploy discipline
rules.text:
`worker/*.py` edit ke baad `py_compile` chalao. Kabhi mid-run edit mat
karo (1-min pipeline-watch cron race → phantom `error:no_log` terminal
fails; real incident 2026-09-20). Long planner run ko `process.poll` se
mat maaro (SIGTERM hota hai) — foreground long-yield ya log-read karo.

rules.title: PostgREST: unknown column = poora PATCH 400
rules.text:
Ek unknown column poore PATCH ko 400 kar deta hai (PGRST204). Column
existence HAMESHA live DB pe verify karo
(`/rest/v1/<table>?select=<col>&limit=1`) — migration file pe bharosa nahi.
Watchdog ne `note` column pe months tak fail kiya tha jo prod me tha hi nahi.

rules.title: yt-dlp: egress proxy MITM karta hai TLS
rules.text: Hamesha `--no-check-certificate`; ffmpeg me `-tls_verify 0`.

rules.title: YouTube 429 / "Sign in to confirm you're not a bot"
rules.text: `--extractor-args "youtube:player_client=android"` — 720p tak

rules.title: `--download-sections` se long video = suicide
rules.text: `yt-dlp -g` se direct URL, phir `ffmpeg -ss <s> -i URL -t <s>`

rules.title: SABR flakiness: single-pass kaafi nahi
rules.text: `ytgrab.py`: 4 rounds × (android→ios→web) × format fallback

rules.title: YouTube ko JS runtime chahiye
rules.text: `--js-runtimes node` (node at /usr/bin/node; deno nahi hai).

rules.title: Supabase REST flaky hai
rules.text: sb_retry 6-try backoff; rerun idempotent (upsert by id);

rules.text: AgentBrain v2 — semantic perceive→decide→act→rescan loop;
